extracted.intended_audience: Researchers preparing manuscripts reporting animal experiments; journal editors, reviewers and journal staff who check reporting quality
extracted.subtask_description: Fillable ARRIVE 2.0 checklists (Essential 10 and full checklist) for authors to indicate manuscript sections that report required items for animal research; used to help editors, reviewers and staff verify completeness and reliability of reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: ARRIVE Essential 10
rubrics_metrics.description: The ARRIVE Essential 10 constitute the minimum requirements for reporting animal research and include information allowing reviewers and readers to assess the reliability of the findings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focusing on the Essential 10 in priority better allows journal staff, editors and reviewers to verify that the items have been adequately reported in manuscripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full ARRIVE checklist (Essential 10 + Recommended set)
rubrics_metrics.description: This checklist includes the ARRIVE Essential 10 and the Recommended set. The Recommended set complements the Essential 10 and adds important context to the study described.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporting the Recommended set in addition to the Essential 10 is considered best practice because it provides important context to the study.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit completed ARRIVE checklist when requested by journals
rubrics_metrics.description: Some journals request that authors submit a completed ARRIVE checklist with their manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A completed checklist helps rapidly identify when crucial information is missing from a manuscript, benefiting authors, editors, journal staff and reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist usage and file-saving instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for using the downloadable/fillable PDF checklists: save the PDF locally before filling and do not work on the file within the internet browser because changes will not be saved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Completion of the checklist using Adobe Acrobat Reader (available as a free download) is recommended. If you experience any issues with these checklists, report them to arrive@nc3rs.org.uk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Example manuscript demonstrating checklist use
rubrics_metrics.description: An example of a manuscript using a checklist designed for the original ARRIVE guidelines (published in 2010) is provided as illustrative material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the example manuscript to see how a manuscript can incorporate checklist items; it serves as a practical illustration of checklist application.
